map.先用基于缩进栈的解析器把 YAML 文本解析为对象：跳过空行与以井号开头的注释行: It first parses the YAML text into an object using an indentation-stack parser: blank lines and comment lines starting with a hash are skipped, and each line's indentation is the position of its first non-whitespace character; while the indentation is less than or equal to the top of the stack, the stack is popped. A line starting with "- " is an array item — if the parent key is not yet an array, an array is created first; if the item content contains ": " it is parsed as a key-value object and pushed, if it ends with a colon a new object is pushed, otherwise it is pushed as a scalar value. A line ending with a colon creates a new object and pushes it. A line containing ": " writes a key-value pair into the current parent (creating a new object and pushing it when the parent is an array). When formatting, the parse result is recursively serialized to text, then every two spaces are replaced with the selected indent width; compact mode directly outputs the object's compact JSON serialization
